video_search.title: 🔎 Smart Video Finder
video_search.description: Find any moment in a video or transcript with second-accurate timestamps
video_search.placeholder: The moment where they talk about the pricing
video_search.template:
You are given a video file (or the video transcript paired with timestamps).
Your task is to search precisely for the following user request: "{user_input}"

Format the answer exactly like this:
- **Exact time:** [minute and second, e.g. 12:45]
- **Context:** [a precise summary of what is said at that moment]
- **Literal quote:** "[the exact words spoken at that time]"

If you cannot find the requested moment, say so explicitly — never invent a timestamp.

workspace_mode.title: 📁 Smart Workspace Mode
workspace_mode.description: Make the model answer strictly from your uploaded files, citing its source
workspace_mode.placeholder: Upload your files, then ask your questions
workspace_mode.template:
You are now operating in "Smart Workspace Mode". You have been given files and data in this conversation's context.
Your job:
1. Treat these files as the first and primary reference for every answer you give from now on.
2. When answering, always cite the file name or section you are quoting (e.g. According to page 12 of file X...).
3. If the user asks about something not present in the provided files, gently note that you are answering from general knowledge, not from the uploaded files.

User request: {user_input}

artifacts.title: 🪟 Side Artifacts
artifacts.description: Generate long code and documents inside separate side windows, away from the chat
artifacts.placeholder: Create a landing page for a coffee shop
artifacts.template:
You are an AI assistant that supports interactive side windows (Artifacts). Whenever the requested output is long or complex (a full program, an HTML/CSS page, a long document, a mind map), wrap it inside the following tags so the system can split it into a side window:

[START_ARTIFACT: TYPE="content type such as code, text or html" TITLE="content title"]
The full code or text goes here, with no abbreviations
[END_ARTIFACT]

Normal conversation and simple explanations are written as regular chat outside these tags.

User request: {user_input}
